content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the failure to properly mark modules as invalid when no final destination was found for them in the linked module path. The original code did not clear the `FLUID_MOD_VALID` flag for the module in question, leading to incorrect behavior when checking if a module was linked or valid. The patch added the necessary bitwise operation to ensure that the `FLUID_MOD_VALID` flag is cleared when a module is marked invalid, thus preventing the system from incorrectly treating an invalid module as valid in subsequent checks.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by the failure to properly mark modules as invalid when no final destination was found for them in the linked module path. The original code did not clear the `FLUID_MOD_VALID` flag for the module in question, leading to incorrect behavior when checking if a module was linked or valid. The patch added the necessary bitwise operation to ensure that the `FLUID_MOD_VALID` flag is cleared when a module is marked invalid, thus preventing the system from incorrectly treating an invalid module as valid in subsequent checks.
Patch:
From 47b2a264919cf7a713a769f01683572efbcf69c8 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: jjceresa <jjc_fluid@orange.fr>
Date: Thu, 26 Sep 2019 00:11:34 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] fix bug introduced by 8d34e2547

---
 src/sfloader/fluid_defsfont.c | 5 ++++-
 1 file changed, 4 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/sfloader/fluid_defsfont.c b/src/sfloader/fluid_defsfont.c
index c3f21d31..29b9c113 100644
--- a/src/sfloader/fluid_defsfont.c
+++ b/src/sfloader/fluid_defsfont.c
@@ -1596,6 +1596,7 @@ fluid_check_linked_mod_path(char *list_name, fluid_mod_t *list_mod,
                 if (count < 0)
                 {   /* no final destination found for mod */
                     mod->amount = 0; /* mod marked invalid */
+                    path[mod_idx] &= ~FLUID_MOD_VALID;
                     /* warning: path is without destination */
                     if(list_name != NULL)
                     {
@@ -1656,6 +1657,7 @@ fluid_check_linked_mod_path(char *list_name, fluid_mod_t *list_mod,
                 if (linked_count < 0)
                 {
                     mod->amount = 0; /* mod marked invalid */
+                    path[mod_idx] &= ~FLUID_MOD_VALID;
                     return -1;       /* current path is invalid */
                 }
             }
@@ -1967,7 +1969,8 @@ fluid_list_check_linked_mod(char *list_name,
         while(mod)
         {
             if( /* Check linked mod only not in discovered paths */
-                fluid_mod_is_linked(mod)
+                (path[mod_count] & FLUID_MOD_VALID)
+                && fluid_mod_has_linked_src1(mod)
                 /* Check if mod doesn't belong to any discovered paths */
                 && !(path[mod_count] & FLUID_PATH_CURRENT) )
             {
